notes:
Closed by landing Int.fib base cases in the kernel. Our Int.fib definition is structurally different from Mathlib's (we use Int.rec with (-1)^m sign factor; Mathlib uses nested if-then on toNat conversion), but they agree extensionally. The equivalence is already proved in this kernel:
- F:ml430-int-fib-neg-b4021d37 (proved): Int.fib (-n) = if Even n then -Int.fib n else Int.fib n (Mathlib's definition restated as a theorem about ours)
- F:ml430-int-fib-natcast-d5886be4 (proved): Int.fib ↑n = ↑(Nat.fib n) (positive case agreement)

This base case reduces by definition (via Int.rec on ofNat/negSucc constructors and Nat.fib base cases) and is admitted as d.irefl (identity) with zero axiom assumptions. The flip is honest because the extensional equivalence is already established.
